Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1- This Limited tender enquiry bid is restricted for vendors who are established for su bject item “ALTERED CLOTH BAG (EMPTY) FRC” or similar item i.e. “SET OF IGNIT ER TOP & BOTTOM CLOTH BAG (EMPTY) (LF-9911358667)’’ and also registered wi th any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB for the subject item or similar item as m entioned above. If any firm/firms participate in the bid & give certificate that the firm is established (with MIL group of factories/erstwhile OFB) before bid opening and regi stered with (any factory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB) for the subject or similar item as mentioned above then offer of that firm/firms may be considered for technical eva luation, rest firms shall be rejected during technical evaluation. Established suppli ers also have to get themselves registered for the tendered/similar item as mentioned above before bid opening if their registration has expired. 2- Offer of those bidders who are not established and registered source of the subjec t item/similar item as mentioned above under procurement at OFK shall be rejected/i gnored. 3- Inspection to be carried out as per inspection document i.e. QAP, Specification & D rawings as part of TE & Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent along with the Suppl y. The Material will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the So le Criteria for acceptance of the Item. Place of Inspection & Authority:- at O F Khamaria, Raw Material/Advance Sample/Bulk Quantity: CGM/(OF) KHAMARIA or his authorized representative. 4- Bidders have to either submit Registration Certificate for subject item (with any fa ctory/Unit under MIL/erstwhile OFB) OR submit duly filled vendor registration request form (VRRF) in case the firm is not registered or its registration has expired. The VRR F form can be filled online (through link-vendor.munitionsindia.in) with requisite appli cation fee along with 18% GST for item registration. In case the online link does not work then the firm has to submit duly filled & signed VRRF offline including all the required details & requisite documents for Capacity veri fication along with the Bid else the offer of the Bidder will not be considered. Further the Bidder also has to pay requisite application fee along with 18% GST for item regis tration through online mode only and upload the payment receipt along with the Bid. The format of VRRF and payment details (i.e. fees amount & Bank account details) ha

s been uploaded with the Bid & is available in “Buyer uploaded ATC document” secti on of the Bid Document. 5. Advance sample as per QAP/Drawing/specification. (If applicable) 6. Bidder has to submit Udyam Registration Certificate for availing Purchase preferen ce clause of Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs). 7. Bidder has to submit the MII document/certificate mentioning the % age of local co ntent of material to be supplied. 8. Option clause: 50% OC applicable. 9. DP shall include supply of full order including all the inspection process involving r aw material inspection, stage/final inspection before bulk supply as per drawing and specification. 10. Compliance statement is enclosed herewith. Bidder has to submit this complianc e statement completely filled & duly signed with seal of the firm. 11. If any firm is found as debarred/suspended for the subject item at any stage before placing of supply order, Bid of that firm will not be considered for further evaluation. 12. NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to b e uploaded with bid: (i). I M/s. ....... hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provisi on, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. (ii). If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 13. A Model ECS Mandate Format is being uploaded with the Bid. The Bidders ar e requested to submit this Mandate Format during tender finalization i.e. the fir m has to submit completely and correctly filled Mandate Format at the time of s upplying the material. 14. Performance Security deposit is to be submitted by the supplier as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) will be more than 5 Lakhs (within 3 0 days from the date of awarding of contract). 15. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’ s hired labourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 220/ton from the regular bills of firm. NOTE: Bidders may please note that GEM is capturing & showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. Note:- Eligible Bidders are requested to go through the attached Drawing, QAP/ Specification and Tender Terms & Conditions and should satisfy themselves bef ore participating in the tender. Any discrepancy should be intimated to the Buy
er before Bid opening date. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
